content: पतनम् [पत्-भावे ल्युट्] .²1 The act of flying or coming down, alighting, descending, throwing oneself down at. .²2 Setting (as of the sun). .²3 Going down to hell; निरये चैव पतनम् <ls>Ms. 6. 61</ls>. .²4 Apostacy. .²5 Falling from dignity, virtue <ab>&c.</ab> अनिग्रहाच्चेन्द्रियाणां नरः पतनमृच्छति <ls>Y. 3. 219</ls>. .²6 Fall, decline, ruin, adversity (<ab>opp.</ab> उदय or उच्छ्राय); ग्रहाधीना नरेन्द्राणामुच्छ्रायाः पतनानि च <ls>Y. 1. 308</ls>. .²7 Death. .²8 Hanging down, becoming flaccid (as breasts). .²9 Miscarriage. .²10 (In <ab>arith.</ab>) Subtraction. .²11 The latitude of a planet.
